Data and models a reader drives: simulators, explorable explanations and dashboards where every mark leads to its source.

The concept behind it: [Data visualisation](@/glossary/data-visualisation.md).

Services that draw on it: [Interactive data products and simulators](@/services/interactive-data-products.md).

Practised with: [HTML](@/glossary/html.md), [JavaScript](@/glossary/javascript.md), [Flowbite Pro](@/glossary/flowbite-pro.md), [GitHub Pages](@/glossary/github-pages.md), [Python](@/glossary/python.md), [Shell](@/glossary/shell.md), [Tailwind CSS](@/glossary/tailwind-css.md) and [Alpine.js](@/glossary/alpine-js.md).

Public work whose own words show it: [algoglyph](https://github.com/korczis/algoglyph), [sonic-playground](https://github.com/korczis/sonic-playground), [prismatic-flipperzero](https://github.com/korczis/prismatic-flipperzero) and [kompendium-epistemicke-anihilace](https://github.com/korczis/kompendium-epistemicke-anihilace).

How to read this page: the definition is the experience vocabulary's; the services, technologies, public [repositories](@/glossary/repository.md) and use cases are derived and each links to its page.
